# PPRO x GrowthBook: recap, docs and next steps
Date: 2026-10-27 | Duration: 22.709999084472656m

## Summary
The discussion covered integration planning, commercial terms, contract conditions, security, and next steps. The open-source setup can begin immediately, while data warehouse integration depends mainly on agreeing metric definitions; the technical process itself is not difficult. Enterprise licensing includes unlimited experimentation and traffic, with self-hosting priced at a $75,000 base license and a modeled annual seat cost of $1,000 for 50 seats. Self-hosting receives a 5% base-license discount, and higher seat volumes may reduce annual seat pricing to $750. Human GrowthBook users count as seats, while configuration delivery and SDK distribution do not create additional charges; API and high-availability requirements remain areas for clarification. A narrow multi-year break clause and quarterly payments may be possible, subject to tradeoffs. ROI materials and case studies are available, but internal approval is still pending. Draft paperwork, a Monday follow-up, and a quick kickoff are being coordinated.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Self-hosting, Experimentation, SDK integration, Enterprise pricing, Service-level agreements
